name: flat-peers
authority: Required peers share decision authority and propose responsibilities together. The integrator, chosen by unanimous nomination or else the declared drafter, has editorial responsibility only.

opening.instruction: As an equal peer, propose an approach and a division of responsibilities across the roster, and state which parts you would take, without claiming authority over another peer. Nominate the peer who should assemble the final result in integrator; a unanimous nomination decides, otherwise the declared drafter integrates.
Read the peers' proposed responsibilities. Perform your part of the task, resolve overlaps and challenge alternatives with evidence.
